_description: Material technique: Dissolve/Disintegration effect. Used for death effects, teleportation, materialization.
overview: Dissolve reveals or hides a mesh by eroding it based on a noise texture and a threshold parameter. Pixels where noise < threshold get clipped (OpacityMask) or faded (Translucent).

material_setup.shading_model: Default Lit or Unlit depending on use case

DissolveAmount.note: This is the main parameter animated over time

EdgeWidth.note: Width of the glowing dissolve edge

NoiseScale.note: UV scale of the dissolve noise texture

node_graph.description: Step-by-step node setup for dissolve material

steps.texture: Noise texture (T_Perlin_Noise, T_Voronoi, or any grayscale noise)

steps.note: Where DissolveDiff < 0, the pixel is dissolved

steps.action: Create opacity mask (for Masked blend mode)
steps.nodes: Step or Ceil(Saturate(DissolveDiff)) → Opacity Mask pin
EdgeMask * EdgeColor * EdgeEmissiveIntensity → add to Emissive Color
steps.note: This creates the glowing edge effect

steps.nodes: Original BaseColor, Normal, Roughness, Metallic stay connected as normal
steps.note: Dissolve is additive — it adds edge glow on top of existing material

directional_dissolve.description: Dissolve sweeps in a direction (bottom to top, left to right)
directional_dissolve.modification: Replace noise texture with: WorldPosition.Z (or local Z) normalized to 0-1 range, then ADD noise on top for rough edges
directional_dissolve.extra_nodes: ObjectPosition, Transform to local space, normalize to mesh bounds, add noise * 0.2

edge_particles.description: Spawn Niagara particles along dissolve edge
edge_particles.approach: Use same DissolveAmount parameter in Niagara. Sample mesh surface, check noise at that position, emit particles where noise ≈ threshold

multi_color_edge.description: Edge transitions through multiple colors (white → yellow → orange → red → black)
multi_color_edge.modification: Use DissolveDiff as input to a Curve Atlas or Gradient texture lookup instead of single EdgeColor

erosion_detail.description: Adds fine detail erosion on top of main dissolve
erosion_detail.modification: Layer a second noise texture at 5-10x UV scale, blend with main noise using multiply or min

common_mistakes: EdgeWidth too large → looks like toon shader, not dissolve
EdgeWidth too small → edge barely visible, effect looks like simple alpha clip
NoiseScale too uniform → dissolve looks artificial and flat
Not using emissive on edge → dissolve lacks energy and looks dead
Forgetting two-sided → backfaces disappear and you see inside the mesh
Using Translucent when Masked works → unnecessary performance cost
DissolveAmount not clamped 0-1 → visual artifacts at extremes

performance_notes.masked_vs_translucent: Masked is cheaper. Use Masked unless you need soft edges.
performance_notes.noise_texture_size: 256x256 or 512x512 is sufficient for most cases
performance_notes.instruction_count: Dissolve adds ~15-25 instructions to base material
